_doc: Descriptor-level redirects for NEW MeSH descriptors (9-digit UIs, 2018+) that have ~no local tags because the older literature is indexed under the tree PARENT and NLM never re-tags. Applied AFTER a query resolves (any surface form: name, entry term, singular, window residual): the resolved descriptor is swapped for `to`, which must be a tree parent whose pool is clinically the same thing (Uveal Melanoma ~ Uveal Neoplasms), never a different-scale concept (Spatial Transcriptomics -> Gene Expression Profiling is NOT this). Counts are folded local pubs on staging, 2026-09-15 (Projects/probe-new-descriptor-parents.ts). A curated.csv alias cannot do this: aliases never override a native name/entry term.

redirects.note: 1 local pub vs 141 under the parent; Melanoma (1,682) is the other parent and too broad.
28 vs 1,682. MeSH Melanoma IS cutaneous melanoma by default; Skin Neoplasms (3,176) is the other parent and includes non-melanoma.
1 vs 644; sole parent. TKI papers were tagged Protein Kinase Inhibitors until the 2022 descriptor.
0 vs 610. Endovascular Procedures (2,314) is the other parent and too broad.
2 vs 2,893. Community-Acquired Infections (92) is the other parent; CAP papers carry both tags and the head noun is the pool a searcher wants.
0 vs 112. Hypertrophy, Left Ventricular (332) is the other parent and the wrong disease.
0 vs 438; sole parent. Y-90 papers are tagged Embolization, Therapeutic + Yttrium Radioisotopes.
